name: small-space-home
description: Fit more life into a smaller footprint.

interface.longDescription: Fit more life into a smaller footprint. Includes a launch screen, side-panel workspace, editable input controls and real computations: Check the studio footprint; Compare storage footprints; Check open and closed furniture. Imports and exports its own versioned documents. Uses supplied information; no live lookup or background monitoring.
defaultPrompt: Help me check the studio footprint.

prompts: Help me check the studio footprint.
Help me check open and closed furniture.

positive.description: Open the launch screen without calculating.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the actual launch screen with three distinct workflow cards. No computation or file access.

positive.prompt: Open the Nook Fit: Small Spaces workspace beside this chat.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the editable workspace and labeled illustrative inputs. No computation starts automatically.

positive.description: Check the studio footprint. Reproducible inputs: {"width_cm":400,"depth_cm":500,"furniture":[{"name":"Sofa","width_cm":180,"depth_cm":85,"x_cm":20,"y_cm":20},{"name":"Table","width_cm":90,"depth_cm":50,"x_cm":220,"y_cm":180}]}

positive.expected_behavior: Uses small_space_home_fit_layout with the supplied inputs. Returns {"width_cm":400,"depth_cm":500,"room_area_m2":20,"items":[{"name":"Sofa","width_cm":180,"depth_cm":85,"x_cm":20,"y_cm":20,"inside":true},{"name":"Table","width_cm":90,"depth_cm":50,"x_cm":220,"y_cm":180,"inside":true}],"collisions":[],"occupied_area_m2":1.98}. Shows the actual room result. Does not fabricate external data.
